briefs: COP31 ends with no deal in Antalya after the EU rejects a text that never mentions fossil fuels.
India pledges a Rs 15,000-crore package for Nepal and signs eight deals with PM Shah.
Huawei launches its Mate X8 foldable phone in China today.
Trump says he spoke to Huang on Sunday and his push to bring him back was "very important".

lead.body: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO on Monday, 11 days after he quit. Shares jumped 31.5%.
lead.headline: Huang is back: Nvidia soars 31% in a day as markets roar back

stories.body: Rep. Jimmy Gomez will quit on 1 December after an ethics report found evidence of sexual misconduct.
stories.headline: Congressman Gomez quits after ethics report finds sexual misconduct

stories.body: Seven Ukrainian sea drones sank the corvette Merkury and hit the cargo ship MV Angara, Zelenskyy said.
stories.headline: Ukraine sinks Russian warship off Libya in drone-boat raid

stories.body: A drone hit a five-storey block in Dymer, killing 11, in a barrage of 458 drones and 45 missiles.
stories.headline: Russian strikes kill 11 in Kyiv region as rescuers dig on

stories.body: A weekend blaze at a Banten candy factory killed 24, with about 30 missing. A short circuit is suspected.
stories.headline: 24 dead in Indonesia candy-factory fire; dozens missing

stories.body: Game 1 starts today at 15:00 CET. Champion Gukesh, 20, defends against Sindarov, 20, over 14 games.
stories.headline: Chess crown on the line as Gukesh meets Sindarov

stories.body: Mitchell (49*) and Phillips (26*) survived 120 overs to save the Test at 239 for 5. India made 720 for 9.
stories.headline: New Zealand bat out a draw after India's 720
